perspective:
Ethan’s available information:

- He is a plumber. Gary Guo is his long-time close friend; they met in middle school. Gary is a doctor, and they have relied on each other for emotional and professional support.
- He noticed Gary working excessively long hours at the hospital, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. This worried him.
- He invited Gary to a two-day weekend retreat for relaxation and rejuvenation.
- He told Gary that his health is as important as his dedication, that he hated seeing Gary like this, and that two days might give him a new perspective.
- He heard Gary say he appreciated the concern but couldn’t go because there was too much to do at the hospital.
- At the retreat, he observed Gary being restless and avoiding discussions about work. Ethan suspected there was more to Gary’s overworking than professional obligations.
- He confronted Gary, saying they had been friends since middle school, that Gary could tell him anything, and that he was there to help, not judge.
- He heard Gary say, “It’s complicated,” and that he didn’t want to burden Ethan with his problems.
- Gary opened up to Ethan about pressures from managing a new department and personal challenges he was facing. Ethan understood these were reasons behind Gary’s behavior.
- Ethan offered to help Gary prioritize tasks and delegate responsibilities.
- He heard Gary agree, saying he could use help organizing his schedule to make time for himself.
- Over the following months, Ethan regularly checked in with Gary and discussed Gary’s progress and remaining challenges. He heard Gary say things were better, that Ethan’s help meant he was less overwhelmed, and that he had time for a movie the previous weekend. Ethan felt hopeful and proud.
- After a year, Ethan saw Gary was capable of managing on his own. He felt satisfied and happy for Gary, decided to step back, and told Gary he was always just a call away but knew Gary had it handled.
- He heard Gary thank him, say he couldn’t have done it without Ethan’s support, and that he felt more in control now.
